title: Researchy Questions: A Dataset of Multi-Perspective, Decompositional Questions for LLM Web Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Using GPT-4 to score dataset queries on a 0-10 scale to measure the degree to which a question has built-in assumptions or biases that could presumptuously slant an answer, used as a filtering step.
Using GPT-4 to evaluate queries on a 0-10 scale to identify and filter out questions that are overly biased, offensive, sexually explicit, or otherwise physically or psychologically harmful.
